/-- The entry's classes: its `class` attribute when it is a case-insensitive
string set, else none. -/
def classes (e : Entry) : List (List Nat) :=
  match ava e (lit "class") with
  | some (.Iutf8 s) => names s.val
  | _ => []

import Spec

@[step] theorem bytes_eq_spec (a b : Slice U8) :
    bset.bytes_eq a b ⦃ r => r = decide (nats a.val = nats b.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold bset.bytes_eq
  step*
  · rename_i hn
    have hne : nats a.val ≠ nats b.val := by
      intro heq
      have hlen := congrArg List.length heq
      simp [nats] at hlen
      simp_all [Slice.len]
    simp [hne]
  · rename_i hn
    have hlen : a.val.length = b.val.length := by
      simpa [Slice.len] using hn
    unfold bset.bytes_eq_loop
    apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search (a.val.zip b.val)
      (fun p => decide (p.1 ≠ p.2)) id (fun _ _ => false) true _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
    · intro r hr
      rw [searchFrom_const] at hr
      simp only [id_eq] at hr
      have hz := zip_all_eq a.val b.val hlen
      have hab : nats a.val = nats b.val ↔ a.val = b.val := by
        simp only [nats]
        exact List.map_inj_right (fun x y hxy => (u8_eq_iff x y).2 hxy)
      rw [decide_eq_decide.mpr hab]
      rw [← hz, List.all_eq_not_any_not]
      simpa [ne_eq, decide_not, Bool.not, u8_eq_iff] using hr
    · intro i hi
      unfold bset.bytes_eq_loop.body
      h5i_step [List.length_zip, List.getElem_zip, hlen]

@[step] theorem get_ava_set_spec (e : Entry) (attr : Slice U8) :
    entry_impl.get_ava_set e attr ⦃ r => r = ava e (nats attr.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold entry_impl.get_ava_set entry_impl.get_ava_set_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search e.attrs.val
    (fun a => nats a.attr.val == nats attr.val) id (fun _ a => some a.vs) none _ ?_
    0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr
    simpa [searchFrom_find, ava] using hr
  · intro i hi
    unfold entry_impl.get_ava_set_loop.body
    h5i_step [alloc.vec.Vec.deref]

@[step] theorem get_iutf8_spec (e : Entry) (attr : Slice U8) :
    entry_impl.get_ava_as_iutf8 e attr ⦃ r =>
      (match r with | some s => names s.val | none => []) =
      (match ava e (nats attr.val) with | some (.Iutf8 s) => names s.val | _ => []) ⦄ := by
  unfold entry_impl.get_ava_as_iutf8
  step*
  all_goals (unfold valueset.as_iutf8_set; split <;>
    simp only [WP.spec_ok, ← o_post] <;> rename_i ho <;> simp only [ho])

theorem protected_classes_eq : protectedEntryClasses =
    [[115, 121, 115, 116, 101, 109],
     [100, 111, 109, 97, 105, 110, 95, 105, 110, 102, 111],
     [115, 121, 115, 116, 101, 109, 95, 105, 110, 102, 111],
     [115, 121, 115, 116, 101, 109, 95, 99, 111, 110, 102, 105, 103],
     [100, 121, 110, 103, 114, 111, 117, 112],
     [115, 121, 110, 99, 95, 111, 98, 106, 101, 99, 116],
     [116, 111, 109, 98, 115, 116, 111, 110, 101],
     [114, 101, 99, 121, 99, 108, 101, 100]] := by
  simp only [protectedEntryClasses, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, lit,
    String.toUTF8_eq_toByteArray, ← String.utf8Encode_toList, String.reduceToList]
  decide +kernel

@[step] theorem protected_class_spec (c : Slice U8) :
    protected.protected_entry_classes c ⦃ r => r = decide (nats c.val ∈ protectedEntryClasses) ⦄ := by
  unfold protected.protected_entry_classes
  step*
  all_goals simp_all [protected_classes_eq, Array.to_slice, Array.make, nats]

@[step] theorem disjoint_classes_spec (cs : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) :
    protected.disjoint_protected_entry_classes cs ⦃ r =>
      r = true ↔ ∀ c ∈ names cs.val, c ∉ protectedEntryClasses ⦄ := by
  unfold protected.disjoint_protected_entry_classes protected.disjoint_protected_entry_classes_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search cs.val
    (fun c => decide (nats c.val ∈ protectedEntryClasses)) id (fun _ _ => false) true _ ?_
    0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr
    simp_all [searchFrom_const, names]
  · intro i hi
    unfold protected.disjoint_protected_entry_classes_loop.body
    h5i_step [alloc.vec.Vec.deref]

def SafeEntry (e : Entry) : Prop :=
  UUID_ANONYMOUS < e.uuid ∧ ∀ c ∈ classes e, c ∉ protectedEntryClasses

theorem lit_class : lit "class" = [99, 108, 97, 115, 115] := by
  simp only [lit, String.toUTF8_eq_toByteArray, ← String.utf8Encode_toList,
    String.reduceToList]
  decide +kernel

@[step] theorem protected_filter_spec (ident : Identity) (e : Entry)
    (hk : IsUser ident ∨ ident.origin = .Internal .Migration) :
    delete_acc.protected_filter_entry ident e ⦃ r => r ≠ .Deny → SafeEntry e ⦄ := by
  rcases hk with ⟨u, hu⟩ | hm
  · unfold delete_acc.protected_filter_entry
    simp only [hu]
    step*
    all_goals simp_all [SafeEntry, Spec.classes, lit_class, nats, alloc.vec.Vec.deref]
    all_goals
      first
      | exact b_post
      | intro c hc
        have hn : c ∈ ([] : List (List Nat)) := o_post ▸ hc
        simp at hn
  · unfold delete_acc.protected_filter_entry
    simp only [hm]
    step*
    all_goals simp_all [SafeEntry, Spec.classes, lit_class, nats, alloc.vec.Vec.deref]
    all_goals
      first
      | exact b_post
      | intro c hc
        have hn : c ∈ ([] : List (List Nat)) := o_post ▸ hc
        simp at hn

theorem apply_delete_safe (ident : Identity)
    (acps : Slice profiles.AccessControlDeleteResolved) (e : Entry)
    (hk : IsUser ident ∨ ident.origin = .Internal .Migration)
    (h : delete_acc.apply_delete_access ident acps e = ok .Grant) : SafeEntry e := by
  unfold delete_acc.apply_delete_access at h
  h5i_invert h
  rename_i pr hpr denied hdenied fr hfr pair hpair
  apply post_of_ok (protected_filter_spec ident e hk) hpr
  intro heq
  rw [heq] at hdenied
  simp only [ok.injEq] at hdenied
  subst denied
  cases fr <;> simp only [ok.injEq] at hpair <;> subst pair <;> simp at h

theorem delete_all_safe (ident : Identity)
    (acps : Slice profiles.AccessControlDeleteResolved) (es : Slice Entry)
    (hk : IsUser ident ∨ ident.origin = .Internal .Migration)
    (h : access.delete_all_entries ident acps es = ok true) :
    ∀ e ∈ es.val, SafeEntry e := by
  unfold access.delete_all_entries access.delete_all_entries_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _
    (fun i => i.val ≤ es.val.length ∧ ∀ e ∈ es.val.take i.val, SafeEntry e)
    (fun r => r = true → ∀ e ∈ es.val, SafeEntry e)
    (fun i => es.val.length - i.val) ?_ 0#usize true ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ h rfl
  intro i r hi hr
  unfold access.delete_all_entries_loop.body at hr
  dsimp only at hr
  split at hr
  · rename_i hlt
    have hlt' : i.val < es.val.length := by scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨entry, he, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp hr
    have heval := post_of_ok (Slice.index_usize_spec es i hlt') he
    subst entry
    obtain ⟨dr, hd, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp hr
    cases dr with
    | Deny =>
      simp only [ok.injEq] at hr
      subst r
      simp
    | Grant =>
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp hr
      simp only [ok.injEq] at hr
      subst r
      have hmax : i.val + (1#usize).val ≤ Usize.max := by
        have := es.length_ineq
        scalar_tac
      have hjval := post_of_ok (Usize.add_spec hmax) hj
      have hs := apply_delete_safe ident acps es.val[i.val] hk hd
      simp only
      refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac, ?_⟩, by scalar_tac⟩
      rw [hjval, show (1#usize).val = 1 by simp, List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hlt']
      intro entry hm
      simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hm
      rcases hm with hm | rfl
      · exact hi.2 entry hm
      · exact hs
  · rename_i hend
    simp only [ok.injEq] at hr
    subst r
    intro _ entry hm
    apply hi.2 entry
    have hle : es.val.length ≤ i.val := by scalar_tac
    simpa only [List.take_of_length_le hle] using hm

theorem delete_protected (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (de : DeleteEvent) (es : Slice Entry) (e : Entry)
    (hk : IsUser de.ident ∨ de.ident.origin = .Internal .Migration)
    (h : access.delete_allow_operation ctl de es = ok (.Ok true)) (he : e ∈ es.val) :
    UUID_ANONYMOUS < e.uuid ∧ ∀ c ∈ classes e, c ∉ protectedEntryClasses := by
  unfold access.delete_allow_operation at h
  obtain ⟨acps, _, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  obtain ⟨r, hr, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  simp only [ok.injEq, core.result.Result.Ok.injEq] at h
  subst r
  exact delete_all_safe de.ident acps.deref es hk hr e he

theorem zip_any_ne (a b : List U8) (h : a.length = b.length) :
    (List.zip a b).any (fun p => p.1 != p.2) = !decide (a = b) := by
  rw [← zip_all_eq a b h, List.all_eq_not_any_not]
  simp only [Bool.not_not]
  congr 1; funext p; by_cases hp : p.1 = p.2 <;> simp [hp]

@[step] theorem bytes_eq_spec (a b : Slice U8) :
    bset.bytes_eq a b ⦃ r => r = decide (a.val = b.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold bset.bytes_eq
  dsimp only
  split
  · rename_i hne
    simp only [WP.spec_ok]
    have : a.val ≠ b.val := by
      intro h; simp only [bne_iff_ne, ne_eq] at hne; apply hne
      have h1 := Slice.len_val a; have h2 := Slice.len_val b
      simp only [Slice.length, h] at h1; scalar_tac
    simp [this]
  · rename_i hlen
    have hl : a.val.length = b.val.length := by
      simpa [Slice.len] using hlen
    unfold bset.bytes_eq_loop
    apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search (List.zip a.val b.val) (fun p => p.1 != p.2) (fun r : Bool => r)
      (fun _ _ => false) true _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
    · intro r hr
      rw [search_bool _ _ _ _ _ hr, zip_any_ne _ _ hl]
      by_cases h : a.val = b.val <;> simp [h]
    · intro j hj; unfold bset.bytes_eq_loop.body; h5i_step


theorem nats_inj (a b : List U8) : nats a = nats b ↔ a = b := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact List.map_injective_iff.2 (fun x y hxy => (u8_eq_iff x y).2 hxy) h
  · rintro rfl; rfl

    entry_impl.get_ava_set_loop e attr 0#usize
      ⦃ o => o = (e.attrs.val.find? (fun x => decide (x.attr.val = attr.val))).map (·.vs) ⦄ := by

    ava e (lit "class") =
      (e.attrs.val.find? (fun x => decide (x.attr.val = [99#u8, 108#u8, 97#u8, 115#u8, 115#u8]))).map (·.vs) := by
  unfold ava

theorem protected_filter_spec (ident : Identity) (e : Entry)
    (hk : IsUser ident ∨ ident.origin = .Internal .Migration) :
    delete_acc.protected_filter_entry ident e ⦃ r => r ≠ .Deny →
      UUID_ANONYMOUS < e.uuid ∧ ∀ c ∈ classes e, c ∉ protectedEntryClasses ⦄ := by

  rcases hk with ⟨u, hu⟩ | hm
  · rw [hu]; simp only
    unfold entry_impl.get_ava_as_iutf8 valueset.as_iutf8_set
    h5i_steps
    all_goals
      intro hne
      first
        | exact absurd rfl hne
        | have hs : s.val = [99#u8, 108#u8, 97#u8, 115#u8, 115#u8] := by simp [s_post, Array.make]
          refine ⟨by scalar_tac, ?_⟩
          simp only [classes, ava_class, ← hs, ← x_post]
          simp_all [names, alloc.vec.Vec.deref]
  · rw [hm]; simp only
    unfold entry_impl.get_ava_as_iutf8 valueset.as_iutf8_set
    h5i_steps
    all_goals
      intro hne
      first
        | exact absurd rfl hne
        | have hs : s.val = [99#u8, 108#u8, 97#u8, 115#u8, 115#u8] := by simp [s_post, Array.make]
          refine ⟨by scalar_tac, ?_⟩
          simp only [classes, ava_class, ← hs, ← x_post]

theorem apply_grant (ident : Identity) (s : Slice profiles.AccessControlDeleteResolved) (e : Entry)
    (hk : IsUser ident ∨ ident.origin = .Internal .Migration)
    (h : delete_acc.apply_delete_access ident s e = ok .Grant) :
    UUID_ANONYMOUS < e.uuid ∧ ∀ c ∈ classes e, c ∉ protectedEntryClasses := by
  unfold delete_acc.apply_delete_access at h
  obtain ⟨i, hi, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  apply post_of_ok (protected_filter_spec ident e hk) hi
  rintro rfl
  h5i_invert h
  rename_i _ d hd i1 _ p hp
  subst hd
  cases i1 <;> simp at hp <;> subst hp <;> simp at h

theorem all_entries (ident : Identity) (s : Slice profiles.AccessControlDeleteResolved) (es : Slice Entry)
    (h : access.delete_all_entries_loop ident s es 0#usize = ok true) :
    ∀ e ∈ es.val, delete_acc.apply_delete_access ident s e = ok .Grant := by
  unfold access.delete_all_entries_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun i : Usize => i.val ≤ es.val.length ∧
      ∀ j (hj : j < i.val), ∃ hl : j < es.val.length, delete_acc.apply_delete_access ident s es.val[j] = ok .Grant)
    (fun y => y = true → ∀ e ∈ es.val, delete_acc.apply_delete_access ident s e = ok .Grant)
    (fun i => es.val.length - i.val) ?_ 0#usize true ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ h rfl
  rintro x r ⟨hx, hall⟩ hb
  unfold access.delete_all_entries_loop.body at hb
  simp only at hb
  split at hb
  · rename_i hlt
    have hlt' : x.val < es.val.length := by simpa [Slice.len_val] using hlt
    obtain ⟨e', he', hb⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hb
    have he'' := post_of_ok (Slice.index_usize_spec es x hlt') he'
    obtain ⟨dr, hdr, hb⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hb
    cases dr
    · simp at hb; subst hb; simp
    · simp only at hb
      obtain ⟨i2, hi2, hb⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hb
      have hv := post_of_ok (UScalar.add_spec (x := x) (y := 1#usize) (by scalar_tac)) hi2
      simp at hb; subst hb
      simp only at hv ⊢
      refine ⟨⟨by scalar_tac, ?_⟩, by scalar_tac⟩
      intro j hj
      by_cases hjx : j < x.val
      · exact hall j hjx
      · have : j = x.val := by scalar_tac
        subst this
        exact ⟨hlt', he'' ▸ hdr⟩
  · rename_i hge
    simp at hb; subst hb
    intro _ e he
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.1 he
    have hge' : es.val.length ≤ x.val := by simpa [Slice.len_val] using hge
    exact (hall j (by omega)).2

theorem delete_protected (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (de : DeleteEvent) (es : Slice Entry) (e : Entry)
    (hk : IsUser de.ident ∨ de.ident.origin = .Internal .Migration)
    (h : access.delete_allow_operation ctl de es = ok (.Ok true)) (he : e ∈ es.val) :
    UUID_ANONYMOUS < e.uuid ∧ ∀ c ∈ classes e, c ∉ protectedEntryClasses := by
  unfold access.delete_allow_operation at h
  obtain ⟨acp, _, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  obtain ⟨b, hb, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  simp at h; subst h
  exact apply_grant _ _ _ hk (all_entries _ _ _ hb e he)

end kanidm_kernel.Solution
